title: Gazebo Publish
text: Send custom messages to Gazebo server, 1 input; {Topic source} sets the source for specifying topic, {Topic}, {Message type} sets the gazebo custom message type and {Sample time} sets the sampling time of input. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Topic source
params.values: Source for specifying topic From Gazebo (default) | Specify your own

params.name: Topic
params.values: Topic name of custom message /my_topic (default) | string

params.name: Message type
params.values: Gazebo custom message type gazebo_msgs/TestPose (default) | string
